must_not_be_primary_when: aortic dissection is the primary diagnosis

cardiogenic shock

typical_findings: preceding streptococcal pharyngitis or skin infection

must_not_be_primary_when: no hematuria and no proteinuria present
normal complement levels with no immune markers
need_external_check_if: ANCA positive suggesting vasculitis

typical_findings: rapid rise in serum creatinine ≥0.3 mg/dL in 48h or ≥1.5x baseline in 7 days

need_external_check_if: initiation of dialysis planning
kidney transplant evaluation
uremic emergency (pericarditis, encephalopathy, severe hyperkalemia)

typical_findings: regional wall motion abnormality on echocardiography

must_not_be_primary_when: troponin elevation from non-ischemic cause (type 2 MI, myocarditis, takotsubo)
demand ischemia without plaque rupture as primary mechanism
need_external_check_if: STEMI requiring emergent PCI within 90 minutes
cardiogenic shock (Killip class IV)
mechanical complications
post-MI LVEF <=40% requiring ICD evaluation
acute myocardial infarction.notes: Universal definition of MI requires troponin rise/fall with at least one of: ischemic symptoms, new ECG changes, imaging evidence of new loss of viable myocardium, or angiographic thrombus. Type 1 MI involves plaque rupture; Type 2 involves supply-demand mismatch.

typical_findings: elevated serum lipase >3x upper limit of normal
severe epigastric pain radiating to back

must_not_be_primary_when: pancreatic malignancy causing duct obstruction is the primary problem
chronic pancreatitis acute exacerbation is more accurate diagnosis

organ failure persisting >48 hours (severe AP)
suspected biliary etiology requiring ERCP
Ranson score >=3 or APACHE II >=8
acute pancreatitis.notes: Diagnosis requires 2 of 3: characteristic abdominal pain, lipase >3x ULN, imaging findings. Most common etiologies are gallstones and alcohol. Severity classified as mild, moderately severe, or severe per revised Atlanta classification.

typical_findings: pulmonary or extrapulmonary sepsis as trigger
bilateral opacities on chest imaging not fully explained by effusions or atelectasis

reduced lung compliance in late phase

must_not_be_primary_when: cardiogenic pulmonary edema (elevated PCWP >18 mmHg) as primary cause
diffuse alveolar hemorrhage as primary diagnosis
acute eosinophilic pneumonia
need_external_check_if: PaO2/FiO2 <=100 (severe ARDS) requiring prone positioning and neuromuscular blockade
refractory hypoxemia requiring ECMO evaluation
suspected underlying etiology requiring targeted treatment (sepsis source control)
failure to improve after 7 days requiring fibroproliferative phase assessment
acute respiratory distress syndrome.notes: Berlin definition: acute onset (within 1 week), bilateral opacities, respiratory failure not fully explained by cardiac failure or fluid overload, PaO2/FiO2 ratio classifies severity: mild (200-300), moderate (100-200), severe (<=100). Lung-protective ventilation (6 mL/kg IBW, plateau pressure <=30 cmH2O) is the cornerstone of management. Mortality 35-46% overall.

must_not_be_primary_when: dental infection as source

sinonasal malignancy

acute sinusitis.notes: Viral URI precedes most cases. Bacterial sinusitis criteria: symptoms ≥10 days without improvement, or worsening after initial improvement (double sickening), or severe onset (≥39°C + purulent discharge ≥3 days). S. pneumoniae, H. influenzae, M. catarrhalis most common bacteria.

pleural effusion.notes: 胸膜腔内液体异常积聚。不是独立疾病，而是多种疾病（心衰、感染、肿瘤、肺栓塞等）的表现。

typical_findings: blunting of costophrenic angle on chest X-ray

must_not_be_primary_when: pleural effusion is secondary to heart failure, infection, or malignancy
need_external_check_if: large effusion causing respiratory compromise requiring thoracentesis
suspected empyema requiring chest tube drainage
hemorrhagic effusion suggesting malignancy or pulmonary embolism

pneumothorax.notes: 胸膜腔内气体异常积聚。分为自发性（原发/继发）、创伤性和张力性气胸。

typical_findings: air in pleural space on chest X-ray
decreased breath sounds on affected side

need_external_check_if: tension pneumothorax with hemodynamic instability (needle decompression)
recurrent pneumothorax requiring pleurodesis
traumatic pneumothorax with associated injuries

polymyalgia rheumatica.notes: 以颈部、肩胛带和骨盆带肌肉疼痛和晨僵为特征的炎症性风湿病，多见于50岁以上人群，常与巨细胞动脉炎相关。

typical_findings: bilateral shoulder girdle pain and stiffness
bilateral hip girdle pain and stiffness
difficulty raising arms or rising from chair

must_not_be_primary_when: giant cell arteritis (temporal arteritis) as primary diagnosis
other inflammatory arthritis (RA, spondyloarthritis) confirmed
age <50 years suggesting alternative diagnosis
need_external_check_if: new-onset headache, visual symptoms, or jaw claudication suggesting giant cell arteritis
relapse during corticosteroid taper
normal ESR/CRP with typical clinical features

anorexia nervosa.notes: 以限制能量摄入、强烈害怕体重增加和对体重的过度关注为特征的精神障碍，导致显著低体重。可导致继发性闭经。
need_external_check_if: BMI <15 requiring medical hospitalization
refeeding syndrome risk during nutritional rehabilitation
severe electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypophosphatemia)
suicidal ideation requiring psychiatric admission

bulimia nervosa.notes: 以反复发作的暴食和代偿行为（催吐、泻药、过度运动）为特征的精神障碍，体重通常在正常范围。

typical_findings: sense of loss of control during binges

must_not_be_primary_when: anorexia nervosa binge-purge subtype as primary diagnosis (BMI <18.5)
need_external_check_if: severe electrolyte abnormalities requiring medical stabilization
esophageal rupture (Boerhaave syndrome) from forceful vomiting
dental erosion requiring dental evaluation

typical_findings: triggers: temperature changes, strong odors, irritants

must_not_be_primary_when: allergic rhinitis not excluded (skin prick test/specific IgE)
chronic rhinosinusitis
rhinitis medicamentosa (topical decongestant overuse)
structural cause (septal deviation, polyps)
need_external_check_if: allergy testing to exclude allergic rhinitis
nasal endoscopy if structural cause suspected
CT sinuses if sinusitis suspected
medication review (rhinitis medicamentosa)
慢性鼻炎.notes: Diagnosis of exclusion after ruling out allergic, infectious, and structural causes. Subtypes: vasomotor, gustatory, hormonal, drug-induced, senile rhinitis. Intranasal corticosteroids and ipratropium bromide are mainstays.

typical_findings: fixed airflow obstruction in long-standing disease

must_not_be_primary_when: fixed airflow obstruction without reversibility suggesting COPD
vocal cord dysfunction mimicking asthma
cardiac asthma from heart failure
need_external_check_if: severe or life-threatening exacerbation requiring ICU
refractory to high-dose ICS/LABA requiring biologic evaluation
suspected occupational asthma
asthma-COPD overlap requiring differentiation
支气管哮喘.notes: GINA stepwise approach guides therapy. Phenotypes include allergic, non-allergic, late-onset, obesity-related, and exercise-induced. Severe asthma (~5-10%) may require biologics (anti-IgE, anti-IL5, anti-IL4R).

typical_findings: consolidation on chest X-ray or CT

must_not_be_primary_when: hospital-acquired or ventilator-associated pneumonia
aspiration pneumonia as primary mechanism
lung abscess or empyema as primary problem
tuberculosis suspected
need_external_check_if: CURB-65 score >=3 or PSI class IV-V requiring ICU consideration
parapneumonic effusion or empyema
failure to improve after 48-72 hours of appropriate antibiotics
immunocompromised host requiring broader workup
社区获得性肺炎.notes: Most common pathogens: S. pneumoniae, H. influenzae, atypical organisms (Mycoplasma, Chlamydophila, Legionella). Severity assessed by CURB-65 or PSI. Empiric therapy based on severity and risk factors.

typical_findings: persistent airflow limitation on spirometry (FEV1/FVC <0.70 post-bronchodilator)
sputum production >3 months/year for 2 consecutive years (chronic bronchitis phenotype)

must_not_be_primary_when: asthma is the primary diagnosis without fixed obstruction
bronchiectasis as primary disease
heart failure causing dyspnea without airflow limitation
need_external_check_if: FEV1 <30% predicted (GOLD stage IV)
frequent exacerbations (>=2/year)
suspected alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
pulmonary hypertension on echocardiography
lung volume reduction surgery or transplant candidacy
慢性阻塞性肺疾病.notes: GOLD classification by FEV1: I (>=80%), II (50-79%), III (30-49%), IV (<30%). ABCD assessment combines symptoms and exacerbation history. Smoking cessation is the single most effective intervention to slow progression.

must_not_be_primary_when: dysphagia with weight loss suggesting esophageal malignancy
hematemesis suggesting upper GI bleeding from other source
chest pain with ECG changes suggesting acute coronary syndrome
need_external_check_if: alarm symptoms present (dysphagia, weight loss, GI bleeding)
refractory to standard PPI therapy for 8 weeks
suspected Barrett esophagus or esophageal stricture
胃食管反流病.notes: GERD is a multifactorial disease with multiple phenotypic presentations. Esophageal hypersensitivity and visceral hyperalgesia may contribute to symptoms even with normal acid exposure.

typical_findings: H. pylori positive on urea breath test or stool antigen
gastric adenocarcinoma risk in long-standing atrophic gastritis

must_not_be_primary_when: active GI bleeding suggesting peptic ulcer or malignancy
significant weight loss and dysphagia suggesting gastric carcinoma
need_external_check_if: atrophic gastritis with intestinal metaplasia requiring surveillance endoscopy
suspected autoimmune gastritis with B12 deficiency
refractory symptoms despite H. pylori eradication
慢性胃炎.notes: H. pylori infection is the most common cause worldwide. Autoimmune gastritis targets parietal cells and may lead to pernicious anemia. Long-standing atrophic gastritis increases gastric cancer risk.

must_not_be_primary_when: alarm symptoms present (weight loss, GI bleeding, dysphagia)
endoscopy reveals structural lesion or malignancy
abnormal labs suggesting organic disease
need_external_check_if: age >60 with new-onset dyspepsia
failure to respond to empiric therapy
overlap with GERD or IBS requiring differentiation
功能性消化不良.notes:
Diagnosis requires Rome IV criteria fulfillment and exclusion of organic disease. Subtypes include postprandial distress syndrome and epigastric pain syndrome. Immune activation and duodenal eosinophilia are emerging pathological findings.

Diagnosis requires Rome IV criteria fulfillment and exclusion of organic disease. Subtypes include postprandial distress syndrome and epigastric pain syndrome.

typical_findings: low-grade mucosal inflammation in IBS-D subset
fecal calprotectin normal or mildly elevated
mast cell hyperplasia in colonic mucosa

must_not_be_primary_when: fecal calprotectin significantly elevated suggesting IBD
alarm symptoms (rectal bleeding, weight loss, nocturnal symptoms)
celiac serology positive
need_external_check_if: age >50 with new symptoms requiring colonoscopy
IBS-D with elevated fecal calprotectin
refractory symptoms despite standard therapy
肠易激综合征.notes:
Diagnosis based on Rome IV criteria. Subtypes: IBS-D (diarrhea), IBS-C (constipation), IBS-M (mixed). Fecal calprotectin <50 μg/g helps exclude IBD. Post-infectious IBS occurs in 10-15% of acute gastroenteritis cases.

Diagnosis based on Rome IV criteria. Subtypes: IBS-D (diarrhea), IBS-C (constipation), IBS-M (mixed). Fecal calprotectin <50 mcg/g helps exclude IBD.

typical_findings: pelvic floor dyssynergia on anorectal manometry

must_not_be_primary_when: alarm symptoms suggesting colorectal malignancy
new-onset constipation in elderly requiring colonoscopy
hypothyroidism or hypercalcemia as underlying cause
need_external_check_if: age >50 with new-onset constipation
refractory to standard therapy requiring anorectal manometry
suspected secondary cause (metabolic, neurologic, medication-induced)
功能性便秘.notes:
Diagnosis based on Rome IV criteria. Must exclude secondary causes including hypothyroidism, hypercalcemia, medications (opioids, anticholinergics), and structural lesions. Subtypes include slow-transit constipation and defecatory disorders.

Diagnosis based on Rome IV criteria. Must exclude secondary causes including hypothyroidism, hypercalcemia, medications (opioids, anticholinergics), and structural lesions.

typical_findings: loss of immune tolerance to commensal flora
colorectal cancer risk with long-standing disease

must_not_be_primary_when: specific subtype (Crohn or UC) has been established — use specific diagnosis instead
infectious colitis not excluded
need_external_check_if: IBD-unclassified requiring further workup
extraintestinal manifestations requiring multidisciplinary evaluation
need to differentiate Crohn from UC
炎症性肠病.notes: IBD is an umbrella term encompassing Crohn disease and ulcerative colitis. When specific subtype is determined, the specific diagnosis should be used as primary. IBD-unclassified (IBD-U) applies when differentiation is not possible.

typical_findings: elevated ALP or GGT if obstructive
dilated common bile duct if choledocholithiasis
episodic pain lasting 30 min to several hours

must_not_be_primary_when: acute cholecystitis is the active clinical problem
choledocholithiasis with cholangitis
gallstone pancreatitis as primary presentation
need_external_check_if: suspected choledocholithiasis requiring MRCP or EUS
concurrent pancreatitis
jaundice suggesting biliary obstruction
胆石症.notes: Most gallstones are asymptomatic. Risk factors include female sex, obesity, age >40, rapid weight loss, and family history. Complications include cholecystitis, choledocholithiasis, cholangitis, and gallstone pancreatitis.

typical_findings: systolic BP >=130 mmHg or diastolic BP >=80 mmHg on repeated measurements
left ventricular hypertrophy on ECG or echocardiography
elevated plasma renin activity in subset

must_not_be_primary_when: secondary hypertension identified (renal artery stenosis, pheochromocytoma, primary aldosteronism, Cushing syndrome)
white-coat hypertension confirmed by ambulatory monitoring
need_external_check_if: resistant hypertension (uncontrolled on 3 agents including diuretic)
suspected secondary cause
hypertensive emergency with end-organ damage
new-onset hypertension in young patient (<30 years)
原发性高血压.notes: Essential hypertension accounts for 90-95% of hypertension cases. Diagnosis requires elevated BP on at least 2 separate occasions. Target organ damage assessment includes cardiac, renal, cerebrovascular, and retinal evaluation.

typical_findings: exertional chest pain relieved by rest or nitroglycerin

must_not_be_primary_when: angina pattern has changed (crescendo, rest angina) suggesting unstable angina
troponin elevation suggesting myocardial infarction
need_external_check_if: new-onset angina requiring risk stratification
worsening angina frequency or severity
positive stress test with high-risk features
稳定型心绞痛.notes: CCS classification grades I-IV. Stable angina implies fixed coronary stenosis with supply-demand mismatch during exertion. Must be differentiated from unstable angina and non-cardiac chest pain.

typical_findings: regional wall motion abnormality on echocardiography

must_not_be_primary_when: troponin elevation from non-ischemic cause (type 2 MI, myocarditis, takotsubo)
demand ischemia without plaque rupture as primary mechanism
need_external_check_if: STEMI requiring emergent PCI within 90 minutes
cardiogenic shock (Killip class IV)
mechanical complications
post-MI LVEF <=40% requiring ICD evaluation
急性心肌梗死.notes: Universal definition of MI requires troponin rise/fall with at least one of: ischemic symptoms, new ECG changes, imaging evidence of new loss of viable myocardium, or angiographic thrombus. Type 1 MI involves plaque rupture; Type 2 involves supply-demand mismatch.

must_not_be_primary_when: positive autoantibodies suggesting T1DM or LADA
ketosis-prone diabetes without obesity
need_external_check_if: HbA1c >10% or symptomatic hyperglycemia at diagnosis
suspected MODY in young lean patient
rapid progression to insulin requirement
2型糖尿病.notes: ADA 2024 Standards of Care. Most common form (90-95% of diabetes). Strong association with obesity and metabolic syndrome. Cardiovascular risk reduction is a primary treatment goal. Screen for complications at diagnosis since disease may be present for years.

must_not_be_primary_when: negative urine culture with no pyuria
symptoms fully explained by vaginitis or STI
need_external_check_if: recurrent UTI ≥3 per year requiring structural evaluation
UTI in males requiring urologic workup
complicated UTI with systemic signs
尿路感染.notes: Most common causative organism is E. coli. Uncomplicated UTI in women is a clinical diagnosis. Complicated UTI involves structural or functional abnormalities.

typical_findings: megaloblastic changes on bone marrow biopsy
anti-intrinsic factor antibodies in pernicious anemia
subacute combined degeneration of spinal cord (B12)

must_not_be_primary_when: macrocytosis due to alcohol, liver disease, or hypothyroidism
normal B12 and folate levels
reticulocytosis causing elevated MCV
need_external_check_if: neurologic symptoms with B12 deficiency requiring urgent treatment
suspected pernicious anemia requiring anti-IF antibody testing
pancytopenia requiring bone marrow evaluation to exclude MDS
贫血.notes: B12 deficiency: pernicious anemia, malabsorption (gastrectomy, ileal disease), vegan diet. Folate deficiency: poor diet, alcoholism, increased demand (pregnancy), drugs (methotrexate). Neurologic complications occur only with B12 deficiency and may be irreversible.

must_not_be_primary_when: CT shows acute hemorrhage
symptoms fully resolve within 24 hours with no infarct on imaging (consider TIA)
need_external_check_if: within thrombolysis window requiring emergent neurology
large vessel occlusion for thrombectomy evaluation
young stroke requiring hypercoagulability workup
cardioembolic source requiring echocardiography
脑梗死.notes: Time-critical diagnosis. TOAST classification: large artery atherosclerosis, cardioembolism, small vessel occlusion, other determined, undetermined. CT/CTA is first-line emergent imaging. MRI DWI is most sensitive.

hepatocellular carcinoma.notes: 原发性肝细胞癌，最常见的肝脏恶性肿瘤。与HBV/HCV感染、肝硬化、酗酒、非酒精性脂肪肝(NAFLD)高度相关。

typical_findings: arterial hyperenhancement with washout on CT/MRI

need_external_check_if: AFP >400 with liver mass
vascular invasion on imaging
ECOG performance status for treatment planning
Child-Pugh stage for prognosis

disseminated zoster

progressive headache with focal neurologic deficits
new headache with fever and neck stiffness
need_external_check_if: new aura symptoms after age 40
prolonged aura >60 minutes
headache with papilledema
atypical features not meeting ICHD-3 criteria
偏头痛.notes: Diagnosis based on ICHD-3 criteria. Attacks last 4-72 hours. Aura present in ~30% of patients. Cortical spreading depression is the electrophysiological substrate of aura. CGRP is a key signaling molecule.

typical_findings: peripheral nociceptive input from myofascial tissues

must_not_be_primary_when: unilateral pulsating headache with nausea suggesting migraine
headache with focal neurologic signs
sudden severe onset
need_external_check_if: chronic daily headache >15 days/month for >3 months
medication overuse suspected
new onset after age 50
紧张型头痛.notes: Most prevalent primary headache disorder (~38% population). Diagnosis by ICHD-3 criteria. Distinguished from migraine by absence of nausea/vomiting, photophobia/phonophobia (only one allowed), and not aggravated by physical activity.

typical_findings: basal ganglia or thalamic location in hypertensive ICH

must_not_be_primary_when: CT shows ischemic infarct without hemorrhage
traumatic intracranial hemorrhage (classify as trauma)
need_external_check_if: hematoma expansion on repeat CT
lobar ICH in young patient requiring vascular imaging
suspected underlying vascular malformation
neurosurgical evaluation for hematoma evacuation
脑出血.notes: Hypertension is the most common cause (50-70%). ICH score predicts 30-day mortality. CTA spot sign predicts hematoma expansion. Lobar location in elderly suggests cerebral amyloid angiopathy.

typical_findings: hippocampal atrophy in chronic temporal lobe epilepsy
progressive cognitive decline in epileptic encephalopathy

must_not_be_primary_when: single provoked seizure with identifiable reversible cause
psychogenic non-epileptic seizures confirmed by video-EEG
need_external_check_if: drug-resistant epilepsy (failed ≥2 appropriate AEDs)
new-onset seizure in adult requiring structural imaging
suspected autoimmune epilepsy
surgical candidacy evaluation
癫痫.notes: Defined as ≥2 unprovoked seizures >24h apart, or 1 unprovoked seizure with ≥60% recurrence risk, or epilepsy syndrome diagnosis. ILAE 2017 classification: focal, generalized, combined, unknown. EEG and MRI are core diagnostic tools.

typical_findings: dopaminergic neuron loss in substantia nigra

must_not_be_primary_when: symmetric onset with early falls suggesting PSP
early severe autonomic failure suggesting MSA
drug-induced parkinsonism
need_external_check_if: atypical features suggesting Parkinson-plus syndrome
young onset 8 weeks suggesting CIDP
asymmetric weakness suggesting mononeuropathy
upper motor neuron signs present
帕金森病.notes: ADA diagnostic criteria: FPG ≥126, 2h OGTT ≥200, HbA1c ≥6.5%, or random glucose ≥200 with symptoms. Autoantibody testing distinguishes from T2DM. Lifelong insulin required. Screen for microvascular complications annually.

typical_findings: fixed airflow obstruction in long-standing disease

must_not_be_primary_when: fixed airflow obstruction without reversibility suggesting COPD
vocal cord dysfunction mimicking asthma
cardiac asthma from heart failure
need_external_check_if: severe or life-threatening exacerbation requiring ICU
refractory to high-dose ICS/LABA requiring biologic evaluation
suspected occupational asthma
asthma-COPD overlap requiring differentiation
哮喘.notes: GINA stepwise approach guides therapy. Phenotypes include allergic, non-allergic, late-onset, obesity-related, and exercise-induced. Severe asthma (~5-10%) may require biologics (anti-IgE, anti-IL5, anti-IL4R).

typical_findings: persistent airflow limitation on spirometry (FEV1/FVC <0.70 post-bronchodilator)
sputum production >3 months/year for 2 consecutive years (chronic bronchitis phenotype)

must_not_be_primary_when: asthma is the primary diagnosis without fixed obstruction
bronchiectasis as primary disease
heart failure causing dyspnea without airflow limitation
need_external_check_if: FEV1 <30% predicted (GOLD stage IV)
frequent exacerbations (>=2/year)
suspected alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
pulmonary hypertension on echocardiography
lung volume reduction surgery or transplant candidacy
慢阻肺.notes: GOLD classification by FEV1: I (>=80%), II (50-79%), III (30-49%), IV (<30%). ABCD assessment combines symptoms and exacerbation history. Smoking cessation is the single most effective intervention to slow progression.

typical_findings: regional wall motion abnormality on echocardiography

must_not_be_primary_when: troponin elevation from non-ischemic cause (type 2 MI, myocarditis, takotsubo)
demand ischemia without plaque rupture as primary mechanism
need_external_check_if: STEMI requiring emergent PCI within 90 minutes
cardiogenic shock (Killip class IV)
mechanical complications
post-MI LVEF <=40% requiring ICD evaluation
心肌梗死.notes: Universal definition of MI requires troponin rise/fall with at least one of: ischemic symptoms, new ECG changes, imaging evidence of new loss of viable myocardium, or angiographic thrombus. Type 1 MI involves plaque rupture; Type 2 involves supply-demand mismatch.

typical_findings: exertional chest pain relieved by rest or nitroglycerin

must_not_be_primary_when: angina pattern has changed (crescendo, rest angina) suggesting unstable angina
troponin elevation suggesting myocardial infarction
need_external_check_if: new-onset angina requiring risk stratification
worsening angina frequency or severity
positive stress test with high-risk features
稳定性心绞痛.notes: CCS classification grades I-IV. Stable angina implies fixed coronary stenosis with supply-demand mismatch during exertion. Must be differentiated from unstable angina and non-cardiac chest pain.

must_not_be_primary_when: AF secondary to acute thyrotoxicosis as primary problem
AF secondary to acute pulmonary embolism
AF in setting of acute sepsis as epiphenomenon
need_external_check_if: hemodynamically unstable AF requiring cardioversion
AF with rapid ventricular response and heart failure
CHA2DS2-VASc >=2 requiring anticoagulation decision
candidate for catheter ablation
房颤.notes: Classification: paroxysmal, persistent, long-standing persistent, permanent. CHA2DS2-VASc score guides anticoagulation. Rate vs rhythm control strategy depends on symptoms, duration, and comorbidities.

typical_findings: myocardial fibrosis on cardiac MRI (late gadolinium enhancement)

must_not_be_primary_when: acute decompensated heart failure is the active presentation
heart failure secondary to acute valvular emergency
need_external_check_if: LVEF <=35% for ICD/CRT evaluation
NYHA class III-IV despite optimal medical therapy
consideration for LVAD or transplant
new atrial fibrillation requiring rate vs rhythm control decision
慢性心力衰竭.notes: Chronic HF is a progressive syndrome. Four-pillar therapy for HFrEF: ARNI/ACEi/ARB, beta-blocker, MRA, SGLT2 inhibitor. Regular monitoring of renal function, electrolytes, and volume status is essential.

typical_findings: systolic BP >=130 mmHg or diastolic BP >=80 mmHg on repeated measurements
left ventricular hypertrophy on ECG or echocardiography
elevated plasma renin activity in subset

must_not_be_primary_when: secondary hypertension identified (renal artery stenosis, pheochromocytoma, primary aldosteronism, Cushing syndrome)
white-coat hypertension confirmed by ambulatory monitoring
need_external_check_if: resistant hypertension (uncontrolled on 3 agents including diuretic)
suspected secondary cause
hypertensive emergency with end-organ damage
new-onset hypertension in young patient (<30 years)
高血压.notes: Essential hypertension accounts for 90-95% of hypertension cases. Diagnosis requires elevated BP on at least 2 separate occasions. Target organ damage assessment includes cardiac, renal, cerebrovascular, and retinal evaluation.

typical_findings: H. pylori positive on urea breath test or stool antigen
gastric adenocarcinoma risk in long-standing atrophic gastritis

must_not_be_primary_when: active GI bleeding suggesting peptic ulcer or malignancy
significant weight loss and dysphagia suggesting gastric carcinoma
need_external_check_if: atrophic gastritis with intestinal metaplasia requiring surveillance endoscopy
suspected autoimmune gastritis with B12 deficiency
refractory symptoms despite H. pylori eradication
胃炎.notes: H. pylori infection is the most common cause worldwide. Autoimmune gastritis targets parietal cells and may lead to pernicious anemia. Long-standing atrophic gastritis increases gastric cancer risk.

must_not_be_primary_when: dysphagia with weight loss suggesting esophageal malignancy
hematemesis suggesting upper GI bleeding from other source
chest pain with ECG changes suggesting acute coronary syndrome
need_external_check_if: alarm symptoms present (dysphagia, weight loss, GI bleeding)
refractory to standard PPI therapy for 8 weeks
suspected Barrett esophagus or esophageal stricture
反流性食管炎.notes: GERD is a multifactorial disease with multiple phenotypic presentations. Esophageal hypersensitivity and visceral hyperalgesia may contribute to symptoms even with normal acid exposure.

must_not_be_primary_when: choledocholithiasis with cholangitis as primary problem
gallbladder carcinoma suspected
need_external_check_if: suspected gangrenous or emphysematous cholecystitis
concurrent choledocholithiasis requiring ERCP
acalculous cholecystitis in critically ill patient
急性胆囊炎.notes:
Acute cholecystitis is most commonly caused by gallstone impaction in the cystic duct. Acalculous cholecystitis occurs in 5-10% of cases, typically in critically ill patients. Complications include empyema, perforation, and gangrenous cholecystitis.

typical_findings: elevated ALP or GGT if obstructive
dilated common bile duct if choledocholithiasis
episodic pain lasting 30 min to several hours

must_not_be_primary_when: acute cholecystitis is the active clinical problem
choledocholithiasis with cholangitis
gallstone pancreatitis as primary presentation
need_external_check_if: suspected choledocholithiasis requiring MRCP or EUS
concurrent pancreatitis
jaundice suggesting biliary obstruction

must_not_be_primary_when: CT shows acute hemorrhage
symptoms fully resolve within 24 hours with no infarct on imaging (consider TIA)
need_external_check_if: within thrombolysis window requiring emergent neurology
large vessel occlusion for thrombectomy evaluation
young stroke requiring hypercoagulability workup
cardioembolic source requiring echocardiography
急性脑梗死.notes: Time-critical diagnosis. TOAST classification: large artery atherosclerosis, cardioembolism, small vessel occlusion, other determined, undetermined. CT/CTA is first-line emergent imaging. MRI DWI is most sensitive.

must_not_be_primary_when: bipolar disorder not excluded (screen for mania/hypomania history)
hypothyroidism not excluded
substance-induced mood disorder
grief reaction within normal limits
medical illness causing depressive symptoms
need_external_check_if: suicidal ideation/plan assessment (PHQ-9 item 9)
bipolar screening (MDQ)
thyroid function testing
substance use screening
psychotic features present
抑郁症.notes: DSM-5: ≥5 of 9 symptoms for ≥2 weeks including depressed mood or anhedonia. PHQ-9 for screening/severity/monitoring. Lifetime prevalence ~15-20%. Recurrence rate ~50% after first episode, ~80% after third. Monoamine hypothesis is foundational but incomplete.

must_not_be_primary_when: hyperthyroidism not excluded
pheochromocytoma not excluded
substance/medication-induced anxiety
cardiac arrhythmia not excluded
panic disorder as primary diagnosis
need_external_check_if: thyroid function testing
substance use screening
cardiac evaluation if palpitations prominent
suicidal ideation assessment
comorbid depression screening
焦虑症.notes: DSM-5 criteria: excessive anxiety and worry ≥6 months + ≥3 of 6 symptoms (restlessness, fatigue, concentration difficulty, irritability, muscle tension, sleep disturbance). GAD-7 for screening/severity. Lifetime prevalence ~5-6%. High comorbidity with depression (60%).

typical_findings: orbitofrontal cortex and caudate nucleus hypermetabolism on PET
anxiety and distress associated with obsessions
autonomic arousal during exposure to triggers
PANDAS (pediatric autoimmune neuropsychiatric disorders associated with streptococcal infections)

must_not_be_primary_when: obsessive thoughts are ego-syntonic (consider obsessive-compulsive personality disorder)
symptoms better explained by body dysmorphic disorder, hoarding disorder, or eating disorder
substance-induced obsessive symptoms
need_external_check_if: acute onset in child post-streptococcal infection (PANDAS evaluation)
treatment-resistant OCD requiring neurosurgical evaluation
comorbid tic disorder suggesting Tourette spectrum
强迫症.notes: DSM-5: obsessions and/or compulsions that are time-consuming (>1h/day) or cause significant distress/impairment. Y-BOCS for severity rating. Lifetime prevalence 2-3%. First-line: SSRIs (higher doses than depression) and CBT with ERP.

typical_findings: decreased need for sleep in mania

must_not_be_primary_when: manic symptoms due to substance use (stimulants, corticosteroids)
hyperthyroidism causing manic-like symptoms
no history of manic or hypomanic episode (consider MDD)
need_external_check_if: first manic episode requiring medical workup to exclude organic causes
psychotic features requiring differentiation from schizoaffective disorder
rapid cycling (≥4 episodes/year)
active suicidal ideation
双相情感障碍.notes: DSM-5: Bipolar I requires ≥1 manic episode; Bipolar II requires ≥1 hypomanic + ≥1 major depressive episode. MDQ for screening. Average delay to diagnosis is 5-10 years. Mood stabilizers (lithium, valproate) are first-line. Antidepressant monotherapy is contraindicated.

must_not_be_primary_when: contact dermatitis identified
scabies not excluded
seborrheic dermatitis in infants
cutaneous T-cell lymphoma suspected
need_external_check_if: eczema herpeticum suspected
erythrodermic presentation
refractory to topical therapy
suspected food allergy trigger
湿疹.notes: Affects up to 20% of children. FLG mutations in 30-50% of White patients. Atopic march: AD → allergic rhinitis → asthma. Distribution varies by age: infants (cheeks/scalp), children (flexural), adults (hands/face/flexural).

must_not_be_primary_when: specific pneumonia subtype identified (use CAP, HAP, aspiration pneumonia instead)
pulmonary edema mimicking pneumonia
pulmonary hemorrhage
need_external_check_if: severe pneumonia requiring ICU
immunocompromised host with atypical presentation
recurrent pneumonia suggesting structural or immune deficiency
failure to respond to empiric therapy
肺炎.notes: Pneumonia is a general term. When setting and etiology are identified, specific subtypes (CAP, HAP, VAP, aspiration) should be used. Viral pneumonia (influenza, SARS-CoV-2, RSV) increasingly recognized.

typical_findings: elevated free T4 and/or free T3
TSH receptor stimulating antibodies (TRAb/TSI) in Graves disease

must_not_be_primary_when: normal TSH with normal free T4/T3
subclinical hypothyroidism with elevated TSH
need_external_check_if: thyroid storm suspected
new atrial fibrillation requiring cardiology evaluation
甲亢.notes: Most common cause is Graves disease (60-80%). Radioactive iodine uptake scan differentiates Graves (diffuse uptake) from thyroiditis (low uptake) and toxic nodule (focal uptake). Thyroid storm is a life-threatening emergency.

typical_findings: Hashimoto thyroiditis as most common cause

must_not_be_primary_when: suppressed TSH suggesting hyperthyroidism
normal TSH and free T4
need_external_check_if: myxedema coma suspected
central hypothyroidism with low TSH and low free T4
pregnancy requiring dose adjustment
refractory symptoms despite adequate TSH normalization
甲减.notes: Primary hypothyroidism (elevated TSH) accounts for >95% of cases. Hashimoto thyroiditis is the most common cause in iodine-sufficient areas. Subclinical hypothyroidism: elevated TSH with normal free T4. Myxedema coma is a rare life-threatening emergency.

高催乳素血症.notes: 高催乳素血症是导致继发性闭经和月经稀发的常见内分泌病因。催乳素升高抑制 GnRH 脉冲分泌，导致 LH/FSH 降低，进而引起无排卵和雌激素缺乏。

typical_findings: visual field defects from mass effect

must_not_be_primary_when: physiologic hyperprolactinemia (pregnancy, lactation, nipple stimulation)

hypothyroidism as primary cause (TRH stimulates prolactin)
need_external_check_if: prolactin >500 ng/mL suggesting macroprolactinoma

persistent hyperprolactinemia despite dopamine agonist therapy

hiv感染.notes: 人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）感染，可进展为获得性免疫缺陷综合征（AIDS）。通过 CD4+ T 细胞耗竭导致免疫缺陷。

typical_findings: acute retroviral syndrome (fever, lymphadenopathy, pharyngitis, rash)

need_external_check_if: CD4 <200 requiring PJP prophylaxis
pregnant women requiring prevention of vertical transmission
acute HIV infection requiring immediate ART

need_external_check_if: platelet count <10,000/μL requiring urgent transfusion
